description: Compare jobs side by side. For "compare the first three", "which of these pays best?". Takes two to five ids from search results and gives each job's pay (and yearly equivalent), work type, job type, how new it is, direct employer or agency, visa sponsorship and ghost-job check, plus which is best on pay, newest and remote.

ids.description: Two to five job ids from search results, comma separated, copied exactly.
